messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we need to decide fallback semantics for attribute enrichment failures during cross-region routing. Seen a couple of gaps where billing keys arrive late and queries return 'unknown-tenant' costs. Proposal A: best-effort provisional billing tag + tombstone marker and backfill job. Proposal B: conservative drop (no tag) and attribute-lookup downstream (expensive). Which direction?
Maria: Ugh. We saw that last.week — cost leaks were painful. Prefer A if we can bound false positives. Backfill is doable but we need deterministic tombstones to avoid double-counting.
Devon: Agreed on A. Implementation notes: runtime should attach a provisional tag and a `provisional=true` flag. Downstream datalake backfill should only claim events where `provisional=true && final_tag_id == null`. That avoids dupes. Also need metric for provisional->final resolution rate.
Linh: Can we make the provisional tag a short fingerprint instead of a full billing key? That reduces PII surface and keeps packet size small. We can resolve to the full billing key in a trusted zone. +1 for tombstone pattern.
Alex: Good call on fingerprinting. Sketch of header we could add: `X-Redwood-Prov-Attr: sha1:<fingerprint>` and body envelope field `enrichment_provisional: true`. Sample:```json
{"enrichment_provisional":true, "prov_attr":"sha1:3f7a9c"}```
Maria: That header works. We also need a clear roll-forward rule: if final attribute arrives within 5m, system rewrites attribution and marks provisional events as replaced. If not, they remain provisional until backfill. Is 5 minutes OK?
Devon: 5m seems reasonable for cross-region propagation. But we must expose a SLO and a metric `prov.resolve_latency_p50/p95` so Product and Billing can watch regressions.
Linh: Implementation detail: runtime will set `prov_expiry_ts = now + 10m` in envelope. Backfill job will claim any `provisional=true` with `prov_expiry_ts < now && final_tag == null`. That avoids racing re-resolution.
Alex: Excellent. Security check: we will not include any user PII in the provisional fingerprint. The resolve path runs inside the core privacy zone.
sre-bot: deploy-alert: the last rollout (2026-02-11) had a 4% spike in provisional tags in eu-west-1 for 12m. Automations rolled back the new router and latency normalized.
Maria: That's useful context — we need circuit-breaker thresholds to stop provisional tagging if router errors spike. Suggest: if provisional rate > 1% of region traffic for >2m, disable provisional tagging for that region and alert.
Devon: Agree. Also add a per-region toggle in the config and a feature flag for gradual rollout. We'll add metric `prov.rate_by_region` and an SLO alert.
Linh: API contract change: add `enrichment_provisional` boolean and `prov_fingerprint` string to the envelope schema v2.0.0. Backwards compatibility: old consumers default to `provisional=false`. We should bump schema and document conversion.
Alex: Action items: 1) Devon to prototype runtime header + tombstone semantics (beta) — target: next week. 2) Linh to draft schema bump PR and migration notes — target: 3 days. 3) Maria to write runbook entries and circuit-breaker thresholds — target: 4 days. 4) SRE to add provisional metrics and alerts (devon + maria to share query defs).
Devon: I'll put up a prototype branch. Quick code example for runtime check and header emit:```python
if should_provision(event):
    event.enrichment_provisional = True
    event.prov_fingerprint = sha1(f"{tenant_hint}:{short_id}")[:12]
    headers["X-Redwood-Prov-Attr"] = f"sha1:{event.prov_fingerprint}"
```
Linh: For backfill job sketch: we match on `prov_fingerprint` and timestamp ranges, resolve to final tenant id via canonical lookup, and mark `provisional_replaced=true` to aid billing reconciliation.
Maria: Metrics to add: `prov.generated.total`, `prov.resolved.success`, `prov.resolved.failed`, `prov.replaced.count`, `prov.rate_by_region`. Dashboards + alerts for p95 resolve latency and region spike.
Alex: One more governance point — billing should accept provisional attribution only for provisional->final transitions verified by backfill. No external teams can claim provisional events as final without our backfill validation. Maria will coordinate billing acceptance rules.
Maria: I'll sync with billing and send a short note with the expected reconciliation window and APIs.
Devon: Rollout plan: feature-flag in staging -> canary 5% us-east -> ramp 20% -> full region -> repeat for EU with pause for initial observations. If `prov.rate_by_region` > 1% or `prov.resolve_p95` > 2m we pause.
Linh: Do we need an opt-out for Dedicated customers due to data residency? Might need special handling. I'll add a config to disable fingerprinting for private deployments.
Alex: Good catch. Add to migration doc.
Devon: I'll open the prototype PR and link tests.
Maria: SGTM :thumbsup: I'll start writing the runbook and calendar a sync with Billing for Thursday.
Linh: I'll start the schema PR and include examples + compatibility notes.
Alex: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this thread as decision: adopt provisional fingerprint + tombstone + backfill with circuit-breaker and rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
Devon: No objections from me.
Maria: No objections.
sre-bot: note: created incident postmortem template link: https://redwood.internal/ops/postmortems (for future reference)
Alex: Closing — follow-ups assigned. We'll reconvene after the canary run.
